purpose: Test a cross-domain observation: latent value can exist not only in owned assets/capabilities but in an actor's bounded ability to shift timing, assignment, load or production configuration. Persist only as a search heuristic under existing doctrine, not as a new ontology or platform thesis.

evidence: Jiangsu's 2026 fast-response framework explicitly treats user-side flexible load as a resource that can be aggregated by virtual power plants/load aggregators and bid by price/capacity.
The mechanism requires measurement, control, verification and settlement rather than assuming theoretical flexibility.
Jiangning's operating virtual-power-plant case had 50 participating firms and 415.90 MW aggregated capacity by June 2026, with measurable upward/downward adjustable capability.
findings.interpretation: The valuable resource is not electricity equipment alone but the bounded option to change consumption at a specified time. Energy demand-response is mature/regulatory infrastructure, not whitespace.

evidence: In September 2026 Jingkou Economic Development Zone described one electronics manufacturer with a surge in orders and a shortage of skilled assemblers while another nearby firm had temporarily idle skilled workers because of order adjustment.
The zone organized cross-enterprise labor adjustment to preserve both production and employment.
Jiangsu public-policy discussion identifies contract, injury, social-insurance and worker-rights ambiguity as real constraints on shared employment.
findings.interpretation: Worker time can become temporarily reassignable capacity, but only with consent, skill compatibility and lawful responsibility allocation. Generic shared-employment platforms are not a low-permission whitespace thesis.

evidence: Huipin Steel describes converting steel processing from coil-level production to demand-based pooled orders.
The platform uses standardized order dimensions and AI matching to dynamically route work across processing-center capacity.
The operating claim is shared manufacturing plus material-yield improvement, not merely a supplier directory.
findings.interpretation: Non-standard manufacturing capacity becomes more callable only after demand is translated into machine/commercial coordinates that can be compared and scheduled. This reinforces BOUNDARY_TRANSLATION before capacity routing.

evidence: Yixing's 2026 shared scientific-resource program reported the paired condition directly: some enterprise equipment had low utilization while some laboratories were overloaded at busy times and idle at others.
A shared network involving 30 firms was formed to expose and route equipment/laboratory capacity.
Scientific-instrument reservation systems explicitly recycle available time slots through scheduling.
findings.interpretation: Time-slot capacity is perishable and can be routed when asset identity, access rules, skills and reservation state are legible. Generic laboratory-sharing platforms are already organized.

evidence: Xuzhou/Suining public-property listings show multi-thousand-square-metre cold-storage assets offered as 3-5 year whole-site leases and later transacted.

A commercial warehouse-matching network simultaneously lists Xuzhou demand at very different grains, including 100-square-metre frozen custody, 1000-square-metre sub-one-year ordinary storage and larger cold/bonded requirements.
findings.interpretation: Capacity fragmentation/shorter contract duration is already a real market service. Do not infer whitespace from one vacant large asset. The residual must be a specific incompatibility such as temperature class, qualification, location, minimum batch, handling or bonded status.

search_rules_refined.name: FLEXIBILITY_CALLABILITY_GATE
questions: What can the actor change without destroying its own core value: timing, load, assignment, sequence, capacity, location or configuration?
What is the valid time window before that flexibility expires?
Can the flexible quantity/state be measured and exposed in real time?
Who has legal/contractual authority to reassign it?
Can the receiving task be represented in compatible units?
What safety, quality, skill, labor, rights or settlement constraints apply?
How is successful response/use verified and paid/credited?
search_rules_refined.relationship_to_existing_doctrine: Cross-domain synthesis of TIME_TO_VALUE_GATE, DEMAND_AGGREGATION, BOUNDARY_TRANSLATION, VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION and ACCESS_THRESHOLD_COLLAPSE; not a new top-level ontology.

search_rules_refined.name: PERISHABLE_CAPACITY
search_rules_refined.pattern: capacity/flexibility exists only in a bounded time window + unused window expires permanently + compatible demand exists -> routing value depends on timely state visibility and acceptance
search_rules_refined.boundary: Unused time alone is not opportunity. Require authorization, compatibility, measurable value loss from expiry, and evidence that routing changes outcomes.

search_rules_refined.name: STANDARDIZATION_BEFORE_ROUTING
search_rules_refined.pattern: heterogeneous task/capacity cannot be efficiently routed until both sides share decision-relevant coordinates
search_rules_refined.boundary: A directory of idle assets/capabilities does not create callability when task specification, quality evidence, rights or acceptance conditions remain incomparable.
